records.title: Speculative Diffusion Decoding for Accelerated Language Generation
records.reason: Speculative diffusion decoding accelerates language generation, with reported inference speed gains.

records.title: COMPACT: Common-token Optimized Model Pruning Across Channels and Tokens
records.reason: Joint common-token and channel pruning reduces model memory and serving latency.

records.title: Understanding the Difficulty of Low-Precision Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
records.reason: The paper analyzes low-precision post-training quantization of LLMs and remedies relevant to efficient low-bit deployment.

records.title: LogQuant: Log-Distributed 2-Bit Quantization of KV Cache with Superior Accuracy Preservation
records.reason: Log-distributed 2-bit KV-cache quantization reduces cache cost and improves generation throughput.
